customDescriptions.value: Access advanced Arduino features — use for interrupts, timers, or low-level hardware control beyond basic I/O on Arduino boards
Interface with the Arduino MKR Motor Carrier board — use for controlling DC motors, servos, and encoders via the dedicated motor shield
Access common Arduino I/O blocks — use for digital/analog read/write, PWM output, and basic pin control on any Arduino board
Access communication interfaces on Arduino — use for I2C, SPI, or serial communication with external sensors and devices
Access Ethernet connectivity via Arduino Ethernet Shield — use for TCP/IP or UDP network communication in Arduino-based projects
Access sensor modules for Arduino — use for reading data from common sensors like IMU, temperature, ultrasonic distance, or GPS
Access Arduino utility functions — use for timing, system reset, or board-specific configuration on Arduino hardware
Access WiFi connectivity on Arduino WiFi-capable boards — use for wireless TCP/IP or UDP communication in IoT applications
